Q00255_Tutorial/30573-001.htm.text: Flame Guardian Vulkus: Tejakar Oroka! I am Flame Guardian Vulkus! My role is to teach the fighting spirit of Pa'agrio to young orcs! Did you get the Voucher of Flame from the Newbie Helper?

Q00255_Tutorial/30573-004.htm.text: Flame Guardian Vulkus: Go to the Orc Village and meet the Newbie Guide. The Newbie Guide will teach you many things.

Q00255_Tutorial/30573-003.htm.text: Flame Guardian Vulkus: First, you must learn the basic methods of control in the game. Let me introduce my little friend, the newbie helper . Follow his instructions, you'll quickly learn things that you'll need in the game.

guard/30573.htm.text: Flame Guardian Vulkus: It is a pleasure to meet you. I am Paagrio Guardian Vulkus in the Temple of Paagrio. Orcs once ruled the world and all its races, but now we live on the plateau, because of the power of the Humans. Yet it is inevitable that the Orcs will rise again, just as it is inevitable t…

Q00255_Tutorial/30573-002.htm.text: Flame Guardian Vulkus: You have learned the basic operations of the game well. From here on out, you will be able to really enjoy the adventure! Take this gift -- I presume you have already heard instructions about how to use it? You now have a choice to make. You can either start your adventure he…

links.text: "I will go to the Orc Village."
"I will go to the Kamael Village."

Q00255_Tutorial/30573-005.htm.text: Flame Guardian Vulkus: Then please seek out the Newbie Guide in Kamael Village , the chief town of the Kamael. He will give you many important tips, as well as an item that will prove useful in your adventures. You can find the Newbie Guide by following the direction arrow you see above your head. …

Q00255_Tutorial/30573-006.htm.text: Flame Guardian Vulkus: Go to the Orc Village and speak to the Newbie Guide there. He will advise you about what to do next, as well as give you a useful gift. To find him, just follow the arrow above your head. Farewell and good luck!
